session.limits: Discrete outer-process samples, not continuous proof. No cross-clock timestamp alignment. Comparisons are conditional on the observed session state, not a lock/unlock causal comparison.

plan.method: Eight serial balanced Williams blocks; four uninstrumented implementations with byte-identical A/A copies each; fixed CPU/environment; unchanged 112-label scale5/min9 suite; 11 retained samples per focus/pipeline/shape case. Each process median is one observation; independent units are eight process blocks. Full per-label gate; no regression exemption or A/A noise subtraction.
plan.limits: Same machine/toolchain, synthetic programs. Within-block predecessor balance excludes seven recorded block boundaries. Byte-identical controls cannot establish compilation-layout causality. No project builds/uploads should run during timing; other host activity and thermal/frequency drift remain possible. Resource observation numbers may differ; value checks do not prove all resource-limit equivalence.

native_execution.method: Preflight and all timing sources/live output on Linux storage. No evidence export or project build during timing. Copy retained files to the local workspace only after timing ends.

limitations: One nominally idle desktop, same WSL host and toolchain; external background work is not controlled completely.
Eight paired process blocks; retained in-process repetitions are not independent experiment blocks.
Every slower original-suite median is retained; A/A ratios are controls and are never subtracted.
Same-binary aliases check timing noise, not independent compilation reproducibility.
Synthetic focus/pipeline programs do not establish a real application distribution or whole-runtime speedup.
Value, alias, continuation, trace and selected resource-limit checks are finite evidence; this is not full contextual equivalence.
published_raw_hash_scope: Redacted committed files relative to this record folder
redacted_path_alias_scope: Stage-prefixed tokens preserve equality for exact full diagnostic path spellings within this stage. Alternate spellings or trailing punctuation may have distinct tokens; aliases do not reconstruct path hierarchy.
